tips.text: Check your Foundry for the mailed Voidrig blueprints before spending any Necraloid standing.
Queue all four components at once so you wait one 12-hour timer instead of four.
Build the Voidrig, not Bonewidow; Bonewidow is the longer build.
Ignore guides that tell you to farm Scintillant or rare gems for the Voidrig; its recipe no longer uses them.
Expect one to three weeks of casual play, or a couple of focused days using Requiem Obelisks.
Treat Deimos as an open world to level in; players who do barely notice the farm.
